course_points.n: Turn right onto A.F. de Savornin Lohmanstraat
Go left on parallel road to junction 92
Make a U-turn onto De Pijl
At roundabout, take exit 4 onto Unieplein
Continue straight water on your right

points_of_interest.description:
ca € 1,60 pp, payment by card only. (no cash !)
weekends only, from Mid April daily.
